column1:
Moderately dovish with risk-management framing. The 50 bp cut alongside language that inflation is “moving sustainably toward 2 percent” signals easing consistent with Taylor-rule prescriptions when inflation nears target and labor market slack edges up (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler; Okun’s law). The focus on expectations and “sustainable” disinflation aligns with inflation-forecast targeting and New Keynesian Phillips-curve logic (Svensson & Woodford), while maintaining QT helps preserve credibility against inflation bias. Implementation changes to IORB and standing facilities fit corridor-system best practice (Goodfriend, 2002). Overall tone: cautiously positive.
